note: Short notes in our own words, taken 2026-11-01. Confirm on the linked page.

pages.title: Graph API versioning
passages: The version goes in the URL path: graph.facebook.com/vXX.X/{node}. Unversioned calls use the app default set in App Dashboard > Settings > Advanced > Upgrade API Version. Always pin a version.

Each Graph API version is usable for at least two years; it stops working two years after the next version is released. Calls to an expired version are defaulted to the next oldest usable version, so code silently runs on newer behaviour.

An app can only call older versions it has already made calls to. JavaScript SDK pins the version in FB.init({version}); iOS/Android SDKs target the API version current at their release and allow overriding.

pages.title: Graph API v26.0 changelog
passages: v26.0 deprecates 47 Commerce Order Management API endpoints (checkout on FB/IG Shops sunset), removed from all versions 2026-10-27.
Protocol changes in v26.0 (all versions from 2026-10-27): pretty and debug params ignored, date_format errors, root GET /?ids= errors (use batch or per-object), If-None-Match/ETag/304 removed.

Rights Manager fields renamed: reference_owner -> reference_owner_rh_owner, matched_reference_owner -> matched_reference_owner_rh_owner, sending_rights_holder -> sending_rights_holder_owner, receiving_rights_holder -> receiving_rights_holder_owner.

Marketing API v26.0: delivery_estimate fields daily_outcomes_curve, budget_guardrail, estimate_dau removed; poll ads deprecated; Instagram Explore feed placement removed; advantage_audience must be explicit for some ad sets.

pages.title: Graph API v25.0 changelog
passages: v25.0 deprecates many Page, Post, Video and Story Insights impression metrics (e.g. page_impressions_unique -> page_total_media_view_unique, post_impressions_unique -> post_total_media_view_unique); once deprecated they error on every version.
metadata=1 node introspection deprecated (all versions 2026-05-19). Webhooks mTLS client certificate moves to a Meta-owned CA from 2026-03-31; trust meta-outbound-api-ca-2025-12.pem.
Marketing API v25.0: Advantage+ shopping/app campaigns can no longer be created or updated (all versions 2026-05-19); async insights report runs return error_code/error_message fields.

pages.title: Graph API v24.0 changelog
passages: v24.0 removes Certificate Transparency endpoints/webhooks and LiveVideo overlay_url. Marketing: Facebook video feeds placement removed (use Reels), lookalike_spec required, detailed targeting interests consolidated, is_adset_budget_sharing_enabled conditionally required, daily budget flex 75%.

pages.title: Graph API v23.0 changelog
passages: v23.0 Marketing API: reach-frequency instagram_actor_id replaced by ig_user_id; Advantage+ audience on by default for new ad sets; smart_promotion_type removed. Marketing API v23.0 available until 2026-06-09.

pages.title: Graph API v22.0 changelog
passages: v22.0 Instagram insights: impressions, plays, clips_replays_count, ig_reels_aggregated_all_plays_count deprecated (all versions 2025-04-21); new views metric.

Marketing API v22.0: instagram_actor_id -> instagram_user_id, instagram_story_id -> source_instagram_media_id, effective_instagram_story_id -> effective_instagram_media_id (all versions 2025-09-09). Legacy Instagram v1.0 ads endpoints deprecated in favour of Instagram Platform IG User/IG Media endpoints. Page ratings/recommendations deprecated.

pages.title: Graph API v21.0 changelog
passages: v21.0 removes IG media video_views and IG user metrics email_contacts, get_direction_clicks, profile_views, text_message_clicks, website_clicks, phone_call_clicks (all versions 2025-01-08). Messaging Events API (page_activities) unsupported; non-ODAX objectives blocked for new ad sets/ads.

pages.title: Graph API v20.0 changelog
passages: v20.0: permission errors return code 200 instead of 2; Comment.permalink_url hidden with only Page Public Content Access; Offline Conversions API deprecated (move to Conversions API offline events).

pages.title: Graph API v19.0 changelog
passages: v19.0 removes the Groups API and the publish_to_groups and groups_access_member_info permissions (all versions 2024-04-22). Ads Insights drops age_targeting, gender_targeting, labels, location and estimated_ad_recall* bounds.

pages.title: Out-of-cycle (non-versioned) changes
passages: Out-of-cycle changes hit all versions at once, regardless of pinning, e.g. 2025 oEmbed: author_name, author_url, thumbnail_* removed from oEmbed responses on 2025-11-03 and oEmbed Read replaced by Meta oEmbed Read.

pages.title: Marketing API versioning
passages: Marketing API supports the previous version for at least 90 days after a new release. After that, calls may fail or be upgraded to the next version; only unchanged endpoints auto-upgrade. Unversioned Marketing API calls fail.

pages.title: Marketing API changelog
passages: Marketing API versions: v26.0 (2026-07-29, current), v25.0 until 2027-02-23, v24.0 until 2026-11-10 (Graph changelog table shows 2026-10-06; conflicting).

pages.title: Ads Insights metric availability updates (Oct 2025)
passages: From 2026-01-12, Ads Insights no longer returns 7d_view and 28d_view attribution windows; unique and hourly breakdowns limited to 13 months, frequency breakdowns to 6 months; totals stay up to 37 months.

pages.title: Deprecated Page Insights metrics
passages: 2025-11-15: page_fans -> page_follows, page_impressions -> page_media_view, post_impressions -> post_media_view, paid/organic variants via is_from_ads breakdown. 2025-06-15: *_impressions_unique family. 2024-03-14: page_engaged_users, page_consumptions and many logged_in metrics.

pages.title: Rate limiting
passages: Platform rate limits: app calls per hour = 200 x users; X-App-Usage header reports call_count, total_time, total_cputime as percentages. Errors 4 (app), 17 (user), 32 (Pages user token), 613 (custom).

Business Use Case limits apply to Marketing API, Instagram Platform and Pages API with Page/system tokens. X-Business-Use-Case-Usage header keyed by business id, with type, call_count, total_cputime, total_time, estimated_time_to_regain_access (minutes). BUC error codes 80000 (ads insights), 80004 (ads management), 80003 (custom audience), 80002 (Instagram), 80001 (Pages), 80005 (leadgen), 80006 (Messenger), 80008 (WhatsApp Business Management), 80014 (catalog batch).

pages.title: Paginated results
passages: Cursor pagination (paging.cursors.before/after) is preferred; time-based uses since/until (keep ranges ~6 months); offset only when nothing else is supported. Stop when paging.next is absent, not when a page has fewer than limit items (pages can even be empty with a next link). Cursors can expire; don't store them.

pages.title: Webhooks getting started
passages: Verification: GET with hub.mode=subscribe, hub.challenge, hub.verify_token; echo hub.challenge if the token matches. Payloads carry X-Hub-Signature-256: sha256=<HMAC-SHA256 of raw body with app secret>.
Failed deliveries retry for up to 36 hours then drop; dedupe. Batches up to 1000 updates. mTLS uses a Meta CA (meta-outbound-api-ca-2025-12.pem), CN client.webhooks.fbclientcerts.com.

pages.title: Webhook subscriptions and API version
passages: Webhook subscriptions have their own API version, changeable in the App Dashboard or via /{app-id}/subscriptions. Payload shape follows the subscription's version, not the version your outbound calls use.

pages.title: Access tokens: short-lived and long-lived
passages: Token types: user, Page, app, client, system user. Default user and Page tokens are short-lived (hours). Exchange server-side with GET /vXX.X/oauth/access_token?grant_type=fb_exchange_token&client_id&client_secret&fb_exchange_token for a long-lived user token (~60 days). Page tokens fetched via /{user-id}/accounts with a long-lived user token have no expiry. Expired tokens cannot be exchanged.

pages.title: Permissions reference
passages: Each permission needs App Review for Advanced Access to data you don't own. Permissions are listed with their dependencies; e.g. pages_read_engagement, pages_manage_posts, instagram_basic, instagram_content_publish, ads_read, ads_management, business_management, whatsapp_business_messaging.

pages.title: Facebook Login for Business
passages: Facebook Login for Business uses configurations (config_id) instead of a scope list, and can issue system-user or user access tokens. Business apps should prefer it over classic Facebook Login.

pages.title: Instagram API with Instagram Login
passages: Scopes are instagram_business_basic, instagram_business_content_publish, instagram_business_manage_messages, instagram_business_manage_comments. Old values business_basic etc. deprecated 2025-01-27. Auth code valid 1 hour; long-lived tokens 60 days, refreshable.

pages.title: Instagram Basic Display API (shut down)
passages: Deprecation announced 2024-09-04; from 2024-12-04 all Basic Display requests return errors. Migrate to the Instagram API, which supports only business and creator accounts.

pages.title: Instagram Platform overview
passages: Two setups: Instagram API with Instagram Login (graph.instagram.com, instagram_business_* scopes) and Instagram API with Facebook Login (graph.facebook.com, instagram_basic plus pages_* scopes via a linked Page).

pages.title: WhatsApp Cloud API
passages: WhatsApp Cloud API is called at graph.facebook.com/vXX.X/{phone-number-id}/messages and follows Graph API versioning. WhatsApp-specific changes live in the WhatsApp changelog, not the Graph changelog.

pages.title: WhatsApp On-Premises API sunset
passages: The On-Premises API ended on 2025-10-23 when its last client version expired. Use Cloud API.

pages.title: Python Business SDK
passages: facebook_business/apiconfig.py sets API_VERSION (v26.0 in SDK 26.0.2). SDK major version tracks the Graph/Marketing API version; upgrading the SDK upgrades the API version.

pages.title: Node.js Business SDK
passages: FacebookAdsApi.VERSION in src/api.js returns the API version (v26.0 on GitHub main, SDK 26.0.2). npm latest tag was 24.0.1 on 2026-11-01; check which version is actually installed.

pages.title: Batch requests
passages: POST to graph.facebook.com with batch=[{method, relative_url}] (up to 50 requests). Replacement for root ?ids= lookups removed in v26.0.
